Barbora Palicová ( Czech pronunciation: [ˈbarbora ˈpalɪtsovaː] ; born 11 March 2004) is a Czech tennis player. She has a career-high WTA ranking of 171 in singles, achieved on 16 June 2025. Palicová made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the 2021 Prague Open , where she received a wildcard into the doubles tournament. [ 1 ] She made her singles main-draw debut at the 2022 Prague Open , losing in the first round to Lucie Havlíčková . [ 2 ] Given a wildcard entry into the 2025 Prague Open , Palicová defeated Priscilla Hon for her first WTA Tour main-draw win, [ 3 ] before losing to Jessika Ponchet in the second round.
